# Test fixtures

Small template folders copied into a temporary folder by the tests; never installed anywhere by the kit.

- `flat-project/`: code in `mytool/`, nothing under the conventional roots, one file under a hidden folder.
- `multi-project/`: three projects side by side (`alpha`, `beta`, `gamma`), each with a `pyproject.toml`; a `node_modules/` decoy.
- `custom-layer/`: a bare layer folder with one skill, for `--from-custom`.
- `java-app/`: a Maven project, two packages, a wildcard import, a JUnit test, a SQL string assembled two lines before it runs.

The organisation fixture is `examples/acme/`; the 1.x layout is generated by `test_migration.py` from a fresh install.
